prompt: micronaut openapi multiple spec files UI frameworks support
answer:
Micronaut OpenAPI supports multiple specification files by configuring `micronaut.openapi.additional.files` with comma-separated directories or OpenAPI files. These files can be merged with the generated specification using:

- `append`: generated specification elements take precedence when duplicates exist.
- `replace`: uses the additional specification content instead.

Supported generated UI views are:

| UI framework | Multiple spec files |
|---|---|
| Swagger UI | Supported out of the box |
| Scalar | Supported out of the box |
| ReDoc | Not supported directly; complete the template yourself |
| RapiDoc | Not supported directly; complete the template yourself |
| OpenAPI Explorer | Not supported directly; complete the template yourself |

Micronaut also supports generating RapiPdf from a specification. Views are enabled through `micronaut.openapi.views.spec`, and multiple views can be enabled in one application.

Sources: [Micronaut OpenAPI documentation 5.1.x](https://docs.micronaut.io/5.1.x/openapi/), [Micronaut OpenAPI documentation 4.10.x](https://docs.micronaut.io/4.10.x/openapi/).
